title: Haʻikū zipline violation appeal continued to January
summary: On September 24, the board unanimously agreed to continue the zipline notice-of-violation appeal to January 28th, a delay both sides had agreed to. The appeal concerns a violation notice over a zipline, related structures, statues, and photo sales. The appellant's representative said the conditional permit application was closed this year after a planner missed the department's deadline, and has since been refiled.
